body:
Triaged the 4 raw, un-triaged kanban cards sitting in the cruise queue (S206-601 iterate on mixforge, S208-10 emily for business, bare '208' papercraft-to-shankpit, bare '210' mixforge-web-app) into a real BACKLOG.md SECTION 243 with grounded scope + phased next steps for each -- not full implementation, a real planning/triage deliverable matching the card's own literal request. Two genuine, decisive cross-repo blockers found and named, not glossed over: PARENA's stdlib/media/audio+codec (design-only, no .prn source, blocks MixForge's own phase 2 playback) and PARENA's stdlib/net/http.prn being explicitly client-only (server-side 'serve' was dropped, flagged in the stdlib source itself) -- blocks the MixForge-as-a-web-app ask entirely, not just a phase. Both correctly scoped as their own future PARENA-repo prerequisites, not attempted here. Card 54 (210-101) moved to Done via the kanban API, which also empties the priority queue.

⚓ ☃
title: 210-101: sprint-plan the cruise-column kanban cards into SECTION 243
